Shell(python3 -c  from PIL import Image, ImageChops im = Image.open('satle.png').convert('RGB') r,g,b = im.split() mx = ImageChops.lighter(ImageChops.lighter(r,g),b) mn = ImageChops.darker(ImageChops.darker(r,g),b) sat = ImageChops.subtract(mx,mn) colored = sat.point(lambda v: 255 if v > 45 else 0) black = Image.new('RGB', im.size, (0,0,0)) rgb = Image.composite(im, black, colored) alpha = Image.composite(mx.point(lambda v:255), mx, colored) rgb.putalpha(alpha).save('assets/satle.png') print('wrote assets/satle.png') )
